### Human PR Review

Only a human completes this disposition. This is review of the proposed changes, not
customer architecture selection, design approval or release authorization.

- [ ] `approve`
- [ ] `correct`
- [ ] `reject`
- [ ] `request_evidence`

The PR review applies only to this exact revision. Passing automation does not constitute
architecture, risk, customer or release approval. Architecture selection must be recorded
in the customer's workflow before the selected full dossier is synthesized. Subsequent
design approval must cite the exact dossier revision there, unless an explicit customer
policy maps PR review to that authority. This reference records neither decision.
